## Install

=== "Claude Code"

    ```text
    /plugin marketplace add bitwise-media-group/skills
    /plugin install python@bitwise
    ```

=== "Codex CLI"

    ```sh
    codex plugin marketplace add bitwise-media-group/skills
    codex plugin add python@bitwise
    ```

=== "OpenCode / Antigravity"

    ```sh
    git clone https://github.com/bitwise-media-group/skills
    ./skills/install.sh --global   # links every skill, this plugin's included
    ```

See [Install](../../install.md) for scopes and options.

## Skills

| [`python-docs`](python-docs/index.md) | Python documentation conventions. |
| [`python-project`](python-project/index.md) | Scaffold and modernize a Python project with uv. |
| [`python-release`](python-release/index.md) | Release engineering for Python projects on uv. |
| [`python-style`](python-style/index.md) | Modern Python house style: ruff is the single formatter and linter (replacing black, isort, flake8, pylint, pyupgrade) with an opinionated lint select set, plus idioms ruff cannot enforce. |

| [`python-typing`](python-typing/index.md) | Python static typing and type annotations, checked with a static type checker. |
